change.after: "list of excluded resource kinds (Endpoints, EndpointSlice, Lease, SelfSubjectReview, TokenReview, LocalSubjectAccessReview, SelfSubjectAccessReview, SelfSubjectRulesReview, SubjectAccessReview, CertificateSigningRequest, PolicyReport, ClusterPolicyReport, CertificateRequest, EphemeralReport, ClusterEphemeralReport, AdmissionReport, ClusterAdmissionReport, BackgroundScanReport, ClusterBackgroundScanReport, UpdateRequest, CiliumIdentity, CiliumEndpoint, CiliumEndpointSlice)"

consequence.statement: Argo CD will now exclude the specified high-churn resource kinds by default from synchronization and tracking, reducing API server load and connection overhead. Existing configurations that explicitly set `resource.exclusions` remain unchanged; this default can be overridden or removed to preserve v2 behavior.
consequence.remediation: Review the list of excluded resource kinds to ensure they do not interfere with your GitOps workflows. Override or remove the default `resource.exclusions` configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap if you need to manage any of the excluded resource types through Argo CD.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 manifest adds a default configuration for `resource.exclusions` in the `argocd-cm` ConfigMap that excludes high-churn resources from various categories (Kubernetes core, Cert Manager, Kyverno, Cilium) for performance reasons.
